description: Tests basic tool chain operations with explicit tool references. These scenarios use deterministic prompts that name specific tools, verifying core functionality works.

scenarios.name: Initialize project and list tools
scenarios.description: Agent initializes the project and reports available tools.
scenarios.prompt: Use the initialize_project tool to set up the OT-2 project, then tell me what tools are available for working with cherry-pick protocols.

scenarios.name: Full pipeline: init, configure, CSV, generate, validate
scenarios.description: Step-by-step explicit workflow covering the main tool chain without simulation.
scenarios.prompt:
Execute these steps one at a time:
1. Initialize the project
2. Use update_settings to set 'settings.general.mode' to 'single_X1'
3. Use generate_csv_template to create 'CSVs/test_pipeline.csv' with 4 transfers from tube_rack_96_1500ul_4 to 384_ppv_55ul_2 with default volume 50
4. Use generate_protocol to create the protocol from 'CSVs/test_pipeline.csv'
5. Use validate_configuration to check the configuration for 'CSVs/test_pipeline.csv'

Complete each step fully before moving to the next. Report each outcome.

scenarios.name: Apply preset then generate protocol
scenarios.description: Agent applies viscous liquid preset and generates a protocol from existing CSV.
scenarios.prompt: Apply the 'viscous' liquid handling preset using the apply_liquid_preset tool. Then generate a protocol from CSVs/example_basic.csv using the generate_protocol tool.

scenarios.name: Upload CSV content and validate
scenarios.description: Agent saves inline CSV data and validates configuration.
scenarios.prompt:
Save the following CSV data to 'CSVs/uploaded_test.csv' using the upload_csv_content tool:

Source Labware,Source Well,Volume (ul),Dest Labware,Dest Well,Source Height,Dest Top,Tip Action
tube_rack_96_1500ul_4,A1,100,384_ppv_55ul_2,B1,2,-5,new
tube_rack_96_1500ul_4,A2,50,384_ppv_55ul_2,B2,2,-5,keep
tube_rack_96_1500ul_4,A3,75,384_ppv_55ul_2,B3,2,-5,drop

Then validate the configuration for that CSV using validate_configuration.

scenarios.name: List all settings
scenarios.description: Agent uses list_settings to enumerate all configuration values.
scenarios.prompt: Use the list_settings tool to show me every configuration value currently set in settings.toml.

scenarios.name: Initialize and list settings combo
scenarios.description: Agent initializes project then immediately lists settings to verify template.
scenarios.prompt: Initialize the project using initialize_project, then use list_settings to show all available settings.

scenarios.name: Full workflow tool with simulation
scenarios.description: Agent uses the full_workflow tool to run validation, generation, and simulation in one call.
scenarios.prompt: Run the full_workflow tool for CSVs/example_basic.csv with simulation enabled and deployment disabled. Report the outcome.
